We Are Changing How The World Trades - Join Us Today

  • NOC
  • Israel

WAVE BL is looking for a NOC (Network Operations Center) part-time position.
In this position you will be monitoring our production environment, handling incidents, answering tickets escalated by our Tier1 / Tier2 support and troubleshooting different technical issues.

  • Israel

  • Israel
